recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future work group decision brings ImmunizationRecommendation back into core or changes the linked incubator resource definition.
issue_request: FHIR-5759 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Public Health ballot comment asking that the ImmunizationRecommendation resource definition include the term forecast because that was the intent of the content.
initial_application: Commit e490b9db1e4bfe85e7ece4ccde849ec813120a8f applied #5759 by changing the then-active ImmunizationRecommendation spreadsheet definition to explicitly describe forecasting a patient's immunization eligibility according to a published schedule.
additional_context: The current core source no longer lists ImmunizationRecommendation as an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation from core and retargeted core links to the Immunization Incubator IG. The current Medications module still describes ImmunizationRecommendation with forecasting wording, and the linked incubator continuous build also defines the resource as a point-in-time set of recommendations (i.e. forecasting). Later issues FHIR-44950 and FHIR-47040 refined related ImmunizationRecommendation status, series, and narrative details but did not reverse this forecast intent.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because the historical application is preserved where the current core build still references the resource, and there is no active core StructureDefinition to re-edit.
